lead.body: Donald Trump arrived in Shenzhen for Thursday's first-ever trilateral meeting with China's Xi Jinping and Russia's Vladimir Putin, at the APEC summit. Xi and Putin met first on Wednesday.
lead.headline: Trump lands in China for first-ever summit with Xi, Putin

sources_note: Researched from AP, AFP, Reuters, Just Security Early Edition, Outlook India, Korea Herald — events that happened or were first reported on 18 Nov 2026.

stories.body: Iran said its drones struck US platforms at Ali Al Salem air base in Kuwait, hours after the US hit Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz. Yemen's Houthis fired drones at Saudi oil pumping stations.
stories.headline: Iran hits US base in Kuwait; US strikes back in Hormuz

stories.body: Israel's military began a 'concentrated operation' in three areas of central Gaza. Trump's Board of Peace accused both Israel and Hamas of failing to meet their commitments to end hostilities.
stories.headline: Israel opens new operation in central Gaza

stories.body: Israel's parliament elected Matan Kahana as speaker, a win for prime minister-elect Gadi Eisenkot's camp and opponents of Benjamin Netanyahu.
stories.headline: Knesset elects opposition-backed speaker

stories.body: Democrat Mary Peltola defeated Republican Dan Sullivan in Alaska, giving Democrats a projected 56–44 majority in the incoming Senate.
stories.headline: Democrats take the US Senate

stories.body: Akvan strengthened into a severe cyclonic storm as Odisha moved people from unsafe homes into shelters. An India–US trade deal is nearly done, its signing delayed.
stories.headline: Cyclone Akvan bears down on Odisha

stories.body: A magnitude 6.0 earthquake struck Papua New Guinea. US health officials confirmed the country has lost its measles-free status as cases spike.
stories.headline: Quake shakes Papua New Guinea
